string.text: What a humiliation for the enemy!Killed ten times, he was never able to get you.However, it is better for him to perceive this not as unnecessary cruelty, but as a good incentive for training.
Harvest time
Hit two opponents with one shot?Yes, you are the embodiment of Death itself!
Skewer
You bring instant death to the enemy.Shoot out two targets in a row with a hunting rifle?Not bad, not bad...
Two shots - two dead
You have comprehended the deep essence of the stalker's craft, being the first to make your way into the ranks of the legendary stalkers.
Careerist
Open the exoskeleton with a knife?Wow!It seems that you are not afraid to set unusual goals for yourself - and at the same time you do not spare yourself just to achieve them.
can opener
Did they think they were getting you?Ha, that was not the case!You stopped two steps from oblivion and even killed five people.
Die Hard
You simply swept them away with a stream of bullets.Five enemies in five seconds... impressive!
Untamed Rage
It seems that the saying «Not in the eyebrow, but in the eye» is about you.Kill an enemy twice this way without dying?Wow!
Oculist
They may be waiting for you around the corner, but they will never become a serious obstacle: even while running, you can hit a squirrel in the eye.
Lightning Reflexes
Let the enemy escape, let him run as fast as he can!Even if he were an Olympic sprint champion, your bullet would still fly faster.
Stop the fugitive
A real bloodbath... You killed no less than twenty, but you yourself remained alive!
Massacre
Even though there were three of them and each had a sniper rifle, your skill allowed you to kill them all.
The most accurate shooter
Let the barbaric methods remain with the enemy.You managed to show that you don't always have to use weapons to win.
Ambassador of Peace
What is the distance for a real sniper?You hit the bull's eye at a distance of more than one hundred and twenty meters.
Lethal Precision
The enemy still got you.But imagine his surprise when he found a cocked grenade next to your backpack!
Souvenir for memory
They killed your comrades and deserve revenge.Three enemy corpses for three of our own killed is still a rather mild sentence.
Avenger
Today you are working as a guardian angel.By killing the enemies who tried to intercept him twice, you saved the life of your comrade.
Cherub
You managed not to lose face and defend the honor of the team!The enemy didn't get a clean win.
Maintain dignity
Do you really know in advance where he will appear?Be that as it may, you managed to pick up the artifact a couple of seconds after it appeared.
Stalker sense
Yes, you are lucky... This is what you need to do - kill the enemy with the last bullet in the machine gun magazine!However, may you have better luck than your enemies.
Lucky
Eight enemies were killed one after another.You challenged them and are not afraid of an invitation to a rematch.
Blacklist
This time no one was able to get you: they are unable to compete with such a careful and prudent opponent.During the game you never died and earned more than fifteen points!
Paranoia
You like to do your job without attracting too much attention, so you always use a silencer.And why does the enemy need to know where he was killed from?
Silent death
The enemy was in for a rout: victory was yours, and you had twice as many points as their best fighter.
Overwhelming superiority
The daring plan to instantly capture the artifact was a success!You opened your team's account in less than three minutes from the start of the game.
Blitzkrieg
You didn't give your opponents the slightest chance to win!They were never able to obtain a single artifact.
Victory "dry"
You won in all categories: most enemies killed, most artifacts obtained, fewest own deaths... Keep it up!
All-around champion
The steel of a combat knife has become an extension of your body.In a third of a minute you managed to gut three enemies!
Rabies
Even the most experienced enemy will have a weak spot.You found his Achilles heel by shooting him right in the eye with a pistol!
"Achilles' heel"
What do you mean by the whistling of enemy bullets?You walk through a rain of death drops.There is a knife in your hand.Your goal is the enemy's face.
Faster than bullets
As soon as something new appears in the Zone, you are ready to explore it first.By finding unexplored anomalous formations, you helped science understand the Zone much better.
Discoverer
You are not trying to avoid dangerous mutants - you are hunting them and succeeding in this.Good hunters are respected people among stalkers.
Mutant Hunter
The stalkers have begun to treat you better.\nOut of sincere respect for you, they leave medicines in your personal box at Skadovsk from time to time.

You have revealed the mystery of the disappearance of stalkers from Skadovsk: it was not mutants who were to blame, but a more dangerous enemy - humans.Your persistence in searching for the truth has earned the deep respect of stalkers.
Detective
The stalkers began to treat you better.\nAt their request, the merchant Sych gave you a permanent discount on goods.\nBeard offers you good prices for artifacts.
Having repelled the bandits led by the Sultan, you gained popularity among stalkers.You are always welcome at Skadovsk.
Your boyfriend

The bandits treat you with respect.\nThe merchant Sych, out of fear that he himself might become the next victim, has made a permanent discount for you.\nBeard, according to the agreement, must pay you a percentage of his income.
You helped the Sultan seize the initiative from the stalkers and take control of Beard's affairs.Now on Zaton they fear and respect you.
Authority
Soroki's swag, obtained through meanness and deception, is given by stalkers to the one who deserves it most.This loot was placed in your personal box on Yanov.
You did not let the scoundrel escape justice.Stalker Soroka has repeatedly exposed others to attack and did not go overboard with his methods, now he will face a fair retribution.
Messenger of Justice
Stalkers have begun to treat you better.\nBandits will pursue you during forays into the Zone.
You have found all types of artifacts known to the researchers of the Zone.Thus, you have earned the respect of stalkers and the close attention of bandits.
Seeker
The gimbal can add hydraulic boosters to the exoskeleton's servos: this unique modification will allow the exoskeleton wearer to move much faster.
Now Cardan has tool sets for every occasion.This will allow him to make previously unavailable improvements.
Combat Systems Master
Nitrogen can carry out a unique modification of a tactical helmet: equipped with an infrared scanner, it will allow you to record nearby people.
Nitrogen received all the sets of tools that a technician in the Zone could dream of.Now he can carry out high-tech modifications.
Master of High Technologies
The accumulated experience allows you to find rare artifacts more often.
There are almost no accessible places left near the center of the Zone that have been overlooked by your attention.You have visited almost all the local anomalies.
Experienced stalker
Your leadership skills improve your team's chances of survival.
Faced with the urgent need to work as a team, you put together a good team.This is convincing proof of the qualities of a true leader.
Leader
Respecting your ability to negotiate, «Freedom», «Duty», free stalkers and even bandits began to treat you better.

You know how to solve problems in a peaceful way.There is no need to use force if everything can be resolved through negotiations.However, you should still be wary of those who shoot first and ask later.
Diplomat
You have worked with scientists for so long that you fully deserve the title of research assistant.Now all the inhabitants of the research bunker treat you as one of their own.
Researcher

Your relationship with «Duty» has improved.If you get into trouble, the "Duty" fighters will try to come to your aid.
Technician Azoth sympathizes with "Duty", so he made a permanent discount for you.
Your relationship with "Freedom" has worsened.
A Hawaiian merchant who sympathizes with "Freedom" has increased the prices of his goods.
You helped the «Duty» group a lot, so you gained authority among its fighters and their friends.But we should not forget that not everyone sympathizes with «Duty».
Friend of "Duty"

Your relationship with Svoboda has improved.If you get into trouble, Freedom fighters will try to come to your aid.
The Hawaiian, a merchant who sympathizes with Freedom, has given you a permanent discount.
Your relationship with Debt has worsened.
Technician Azoth sympathizes with Debt, so he has increased the prices for his services.
You helped the Svoboda group a lot and gained authority among its fighters and their friends.But we should not forget that not everyone sympathizes with Svoboda.
Friend of Freedom
For stalkers on Yanov, the balance of the forces of «Duty» and «Freedom» is important, so the technician and the merchant gave you constant discounts.
You did not give preference to any group and always acted as a free stalker.As a result, you did not make new enemies, but you did not make new friends either.
Balancer
Merchants often offer you the rarest and most expensive goods.

Knowing firsthand what it means to have no money, you, however, are not always short of money - on the contrary, sometimes your financial savings can be envied.Such clients are a great joy for a merchant.
Wealthy client
The notes turned out to be an additional incentive for Strelok to survive and get to his intended goal at any cost.
You cannot be denied foresight: having found notes in the caches of Strelka's group, you did not part with them until you found the person to whom they belonged.
Keeper of Secrets

You were able to survive the ejection without hiding in a shelter - you were saved by anabiotic pills.This had an ambiguous effect on your psyche: a strange silence fell in your head.You no longer seem to hear a constant stream of thoughts.
Marked by Zone
Merchant Sych gave you a discount as the best informant and colleague.

Whatever information fell into your hands, you always found a buyer for it.Without missing the opportunity to provide information to those interested, you, naturally, did not forget about your own benefit.
Information Trader
Your relationship with stalkers has improved.If you get into trouble, stalkers will try to come to your aid.\nMedical stalkers have agreed to sell you medicines at cost.

When you met stalkers in trouble, you always helped them.These guys are not very united, but in their unspoken brotherhood you have allies on whom you can safely rely both in battle and in a peaceful situation.
Friend of stalkers
The totality of new data allowed professors German and Ozersky to synthesize an experimental anabiotic under the conditions of the Zone.
Even without taking medications, you have a chance to survive the release outside the shelter, if your health is not compromised.

Seeing you as a valuable assistant, Professor Herman offers you medicines and equipment intended only for bunker personnel, at cost.\nNovikov is so used to you that, when making modifications, he demands payment only for consumables.
